prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Columbus OH?
answer_verbatim:
I don’t have access to live local listings, so I can’t name a single “best” salon in Columbus right now. I can help you find the best one for you — quick questions first:

- Do you want UV tanning (beds) or spray/sunless tanning?  
- Which Columbus neighborhood or ZIP code are you near?  
- What matters most: price, cleanliness, newest equipment, staff experience, or private rooms?

How to find the best salon (quick checklist)
- Look at recent Google and Yelp reviews (last 6–12 months). Prioritize consistent high ratings and lots of recent reviews.  
- Check photos for cleanliness and up-to-date equipment.  
- Confirm staff training and certifications (especially for spray tans).  
- Ask what type/brand/age of tanning beds they use and whether they offer different power levels or stand-up options.  
- For spray tans: ask about technician certification, products used, and whether they do a patch test.  
- Visit in person: is the shop tidy, are towels/new eye protection provided, are staff friendly and informative?  
- Compare pricing and package deals, but don’t prioritize low price over safety and cleanliness.

Red flags
- Dirty facility or equipment, no eye protection.  
- Pushy sales tactics for costly packages.  
- Very old or visibly damaged beds.  
- No clear answers about technician training or products.

Common chains to check (many have multiple Columbus-area locations)
- Palm Beach Tan  
- Sun Tan City  
- Tan Republic / boutique spray-tan studios

If you tell me your ZIP or neighborhood and whether you prefer beds or spray, I can shortlist top-rated options and what to ask them.
